review_evidence: README identifies the project as an ongoing formalization of the single-qudit Clifford-group structure theorem based on Appleby.
SymplecticForm defines the pairing and proves antisymmetry, self-zero, additivity, scalar compatibility, determinant, and special-linear results.
The blueprint and bibliography support the authored theorem corpus; no generated duplicate formal-source subtree was identified.
summary: Retain clifford-project: a formalization of the odd-prime single-qudit Clifford group with substantial symplectic-form algebra.
